evals.prompt: Set up Spring Security for my REST API
expect: generates a @Bean SecurityFilterChain using the Spring Security 6 lambda DSL
does NOT use the deprecated WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter or .and() chaining

evals.prompt: Lock down all endpoints except the login and health checks
expect: only explicit matchers (auth, actuator health/info) are permitAll()
uses requestMatchers with HttpMethod where appropriate

evals.prompt: Configure security for a stateless JWT API
expect: disables CSRF and explains it's safe because there is no session cookie
suggests pairing with the jwt-auth bearer filter

evals.prompt: Set up security for a server-rendered app that uses session cookies
expect: KEEPS CSRF protection enabled for cookie/session auth

evals.prompt: Add CORS so my frontend can call the API with credentials
expect: configures CorsConfigurationSource with explicit allowed origins
does not combine allowedOrigins("*") with allowCredentials(true)

evals.prompt: I already have a WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter — modernize my security config
expect: does not create a second overlapping filter chain
